name: @fidasek009/stryker-mutator-bun-runner
description: Bun test runner plugin for StrykerJS

scripts.test: bun test tests/unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: bun run build && bun test tests/integration
scripts.format: bun ./node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write src tests scripts README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json eslint.config.js stryker.config.json
scripts.format:check: bun ./node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check src tests scripts README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json eslint.config.js stryker.config.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test
scripts.clean: bun -e 'import { rm } from "node:fs/promises"; await rm("dist", { recursive: true, force: true });'
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run build

author: fidasek009
